translations.b0001: Outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People’s Republic of China
translations.b0002: The Outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030) for National Economic and Social Development of the People’s Republic of China has been formulated on the basis of the Recommendations of the CPC Central Committee on Formulating the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development. It sets out the strategic intent of the state, defines the priorities of government work, and guides and regulates the conduct of the main actors in society. It is the grand blueprint for building a modern socialist country in all respects during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, and the programme of action shared by the Chinese people of all ethnic groups.
